name: e2e-final-gate-only
body:
e2e tests are the FINAL GATE ONLY, and are EXCLUDED from the default gate. The default `cargo test` gate runs unit+integration only; e2e tests are opt-in — gated behind an explicit opt-in guard (the existing `-short`/`#[ignore]`-plus-explicit-invocation or an equivalent named env-var pattern) so a plain `cargo test` never runs them — and are exercised only as the final acceptance gate, once the fast suite is green.

This is consistent with the existing plan vocabulary: a plan task's `tier` is one of unit / int / e2e, and e2e acceptance tasks already carry the "opt-in, NOT under the default `cargo test` gate" execution model. e2e may be slow (`requirements.requirement.e2e-tier-real-io`) and, being real-I/O, must obey `global.constraint.no-real-project-test` (scratch /tmp repo only).

AC (review-checked): a plain `cargo test` runs no e2e test; every e2e test is reachable only through the explicit opt-in guard; the gate that runs e2e is the final acceptance gate, after the fast suite; the repo's default gate runs unit+int only.
